mcs.groove~ is similar to groove~, except that all channels are output from the first outlet as a multi-channel signal.

You can specify the number of outlets as an argument to mc.groove~, then use the @chans attribute to set the number of independent samples (and channels in the multichannel signals at each outlet). This mc.groove~ is using a 2-channel buffer~. For each of its four samples, the first channel is sent out the first outlet, and the second channel is sent out the second outlet at the channel index corresponding to the sample.

monophonic: best option for any monophonic source without ambience

rhythmic: best option for drums and percussion when transient preservation is critical

general: balances spectral integrity with transient preservaton

effcient: best option when CPU efficiency is critical
